'''icebreath Chadra-Fans''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 24 October 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif|label=Agents In The Court}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents In The Court
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Court icebreath LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Once again, the name says it all.  While not as... unique... as Abyssins, this deck still packs a whallop.

== Strategy ==

Same as Abyssins, it should be pretty easy to figure it out.  Strike Planning pulls Madine, who pulls Geezum, who pulls sites.  Ardon "Vapor" Crell, Tessek, and A Remote Planet make your drains absolutely huge.  Imperial Attrocity does a bit of surprise damage.  Bo Shuda (coupled with Uh-oh!) keeps your Audience Chamber crew (Kabe, Tessek, and Ardon "Vapor" Krell) safe.  Bargaining Table... if you can't figure that one out, stop playing Star Wars.  Underworld Contacts to keep my drains going strong.  That should just about do it...

Oh yeah, and do keep in mind that Chimes combo still has the retrieval text on it... otherwise I'd only be playing 1 combo and 2 non-combo... but seeing as how the combo is actually more universally useful and still has the retrieval text, I thought it was worth it.

Enjoy... I'm just busting a gut over this one.  Hillarious!  >:D

David Kangas

Shadow 31

Ophidian Agent

Vancouver, WA
